name: image-to-code
summary: Turn a screenshot or mockup into code that matches it, and measure the match rather than eyeballing it.

when: a reference image has to become working UI

steps: Extract the SYSTEM from the image first — the scale, the rhythm, the palette — then build from that. Building pixel by pixel produces a screen that cannot take a second one.
Every extracted value becomes a token.
Render and compare. 'It looks close' is not a measurement.
Contrast is checked on YOUR render, not assumed from the reference — the reference may well fail.
done: the values live in tokens, not at call sites
